text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The Hansen dataset detected a 0.6-hectare tree-cover loss in 2022, which was confirmed by the JRC 2020 reference map (agreeing on 100% of the event area). The MGAP 2021 forest map further classified the area as native forest. The corroboration rule was met: a later year (2025) was observed, and the JRC 2020 reference agreed on the event area. The loss was within the asset boundary and exceeded the minimum detectable area (0.5 ha).
